courseName: Professional Skills in Computing and Engineering

response.courseDescription: 302 Professional Skills in Computing and Engineering Professional development; ethical and professional responsibilities, including the use of standards and constraints, in computing and engineering. (Crosslisted course offered as CPT S 302, E E 302.) Credit not granted for both CPT S/E E 302 and CPT S 401.
response.coursePrerequisites: CPT S 223 or 233 with a C or better, OR CPT S 121 or 131 and E E 261 with C or better; admitted to a major in EECS or Data Analytics; junior standing.
